The first release of LumaLink, the mod tool for [Nebula](https://github.com/keepvaibin/nebula). LumaLink makes, checks, builds and packs mods as `.luma` files. It checks every mod with the game's own validator, so a mod that LumaLink packs is one the game accepts.

## Downloads

| System | Setup |
|---|---|
| Windows (x64) | [LumaLink-Setup.exe](https://github.com/keepvaibin/lumalink/releases/download/v1.0.0/LumaLink-Setup.exe) |
| Windows on ARM | [LumaLink-Setup-windows-arm64.exe](https://github.com/keepvaibin/lumalink/releases/download/v1.0.0/LumaLink-Setup-windows-arm64.exe) |
| Linux (x86-64) | [LumaLink-Setup-linux-x64](https://github.com/keepvaibin/lumalink/releases/download/v1.0.0/LumaLink-Setup-linux-x64) |
| Linux (ARM64) | [LumaLink-Setup-linux-arm64](https://github.com/keepvaibin/lumalink/releases/download/v1.0.0/LumaLink-Setup-linux-arm64) |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | [LumaLink-Setup-macos-arm64](https://github.com/keepvaibin/lumalink/releases/download/v1.0.0/LumaLink-Setup-macos-arm64) |
| macOS (Intel) | [LumaLink-Setup-macos-x64](https://github.com/keepvaibin/lumalink/releases/download/v1.0.0/LumaLink-Setup-macos-x64) |

Each Setup has a `.sig` file beside it: the signature that LumaLink's updates check before running a Setup.

## Install

**Windows:** download the Setup for your system and run it.

**Linux and macOS:** in a terminal, download the Setup with `curl`, then run it. On a Mac, use `curl` rather than a browser: LumaLink is not signed by Apple, and macOS blocks copies that a browser downloads.

```sh
curl -fLO https://github.com/keepvaibin/lumalink/releases/download/v1.0.0/LumaLink-Setup-linux-x64
chmod +x LumaLink-Setup-linux-x64
./LumaLink-Setup-linux-x64
```

Setup installs LumaLink for your account only, so it does not ask for an administrator password. LumaLink finds the installed game, its SDK and LumaKit without any setup. To remove LumaLink, use **Settings > Apps > Installed apps** on Windows, or run `LumaLink-Setup --uninstall` in its folder on Linux and macOS. Removing it leaves your mods in place.

## What's included

- **The LumaLink window and command line.** Start a mod, add its parts, check it, build it, pack it, and run it in the installed game.
- **Mod code for every platform.** LumaLink builds a mod's LumaScript and C for every platform Nebula runs on. It uses clang and lld from LLVM 22.1.6, which Setup installs.
- **Checks with the game's rules.** `lumalink check` lists every problem with its code, file and line. `lumalink explain <code>` describes a code, and `--json` gives the results to other tools.
- **In-game tests.** `lumalink test` builds a mod and runs its tests in the game, with the window hidden and the sound off.
- **Converting existing mods.** `lumalink convert` turns a Riivolution pack, a disc-layout folder, loose files, a texture pack or a Gecko code list into a mod folder.
- **Reading the game.** List and extract the tables, models, messages and files of your imported game.
- **Editor support.** The LumaScript extension for Visual Studio Code adds highlighting, errors as you type, completion, hover, go to definition, rename and formatting. To install it, open LumaLink and go to **Settings > Add LumaScript to Visual Studio Code**. Other editors can use `lumalink lsp`.
- **14 languages.** Messages and help are available in all 14 of the game's languages.
- **Signed updates.** LumaLink checks for new releases. It runs a downloaded Setup only when the Setup is signed with the LumaLink release key and its version matches the release.

## Setup options

| Option | Default |
|---|---|
| Add LumaLink to PATH, so `lumalink` works in any new terminal | On |
| Start menu shortcut (Windows), Applications menu entry (Linux), Add to Applications (macOS) | On |
| Desktop shortcut | Off |
| Check for updates when LumaLink starts | On |

To install from a script, run `LumaLink-Setup --silent`. Add `--folder <folder>`, `--no-path`, `--no-menu`, `--desktop-shortcut` or `--no-update-check` as needed.

## Requirements

- Windows (x64 or ARM64), Linux (x86-64 or ARM64, glibc 2.35 or later), or macOS (Apple silicon or Intel).
- Nebula, for running and testing mods in the game.

## Known limitations

- LumaLink is not signed or notarized by Apple. On a Mac, download the Setup with `curl` as shown above.
- On Linux, Setup needs `--silent` when there is no display, for example over SSH.

For the full list of commands, see the [README](https://github.com/keepvaibin/lumalink#readme).
